name: Element Live THCA Joint | Permanent Marker x Dead Hot Strawberry x Fruit Truck
description:
50% Live THCa, 50% Premium Flower, 100% FIRE! - Each Live THCa Joint is infused with 0.5g of premium flower (never any trim) and 0.5g of strain-specific live THCa. With potencies in the upper 30’s to mid 40’s and terpenes at 5-7%, Element Live THCa Joints boast some of the strongest potency levels of any pre-roll and pack amazing flavor!

*Light vertically; Burn like a candle.*
